h.lost.sub: Check the phone's internet. If it works, the watchmen are unreachable.
h.place_down.sub: {names}. Looks like a power or internet outage there.
h.cut.sub: The other watchman still sees the node: looks like a broken link between them, the node itself is alive.
h.empty.sub: Install the agent on a server and it will show up here.
need.notif: Notifications are blocked, alerts won't get through.
need.battery: The system may put the app to sleep and alerts will stop.
row.cut: This watchman hasn't seen it for {d}, the other one has
home.lost: Nodes will appear as soon as a watchman answers. Watchman addresses are in Settings.
node.cut: The other watchman sees it: looks like a broken link between nodes.
node.lastdata: Below is the last data before the node went silent.
node.gone: This node is no longer in the panel.
svc.head: Services
svc.gone: This service is no longer in the panel.
svc.noinit: This node has no systemd: the panel only sees Docker containers here. Metrics and the silence alert still work.
svc.none: Services you want to watch go here: bots, panels, game servers. Tap “Add” and the agent will suggest the right ones.
svc.stop.text: The service won't start on its own until you tap “Start” or the node reboots.
svc.remove.text: The service stays on the node and keeps running. The panel just stops watching it.
svc.log.title: Log: {label}
svc.label.title: Service label
f.name: Name
cand.head: Found services that aren't in the panel:
pick.title: Add services
pick.loading: Looking for services on the node…
pick.all: All found services are already in the panel.
act.head: Actions
act.hint: Custom buttons for a node are defined in /etc/laputa/actions.ini on the server itself.
game.head: Game server
game.offer: Connect RCON to see players and send commands to the server. Works with Minecraft and other games that support RCON.
game.q.title: New button
game.q.sub: The button is stored on the node and shows up in every copy of the app
game.q.label: Label
game.other.note: The panel sends commands and shows the server's replies as they are. The player list is only parsed for Minecraft.
game.pass.keep: Leave empty to keep the current one
game.pass.note: The password is stored only on the node itself, in a file readable by root.
bk.head: Backups
bk.add.title: Watch backups
bk.nothing: No likely folders found. Enter the path yourself.
bk.hints: Timers and cron jobs that look like backups
bk.note: The panel looks at when new files appear in the folder and learns how often that happens. If a backup is twice as late as usual, you get a warning.
bk.gone: This folder is no longer in the panel.
bk.remove.text: The files in the folder stay as they are.
bk.removed: The panel no longer watches the folder
bk.learning: How often backups appear will be clear after two or three copies
mt.head: Maintenance
cause.clean: the node was shut down cleanly
cause.oom: out of memory, the kernel was killing processes
cause.abrupt: cut off with nothing in the log: looks like a power loss or the hoster's doing
cause.unknown: the previous boot's log wasn't kept
pm.head: The node rebooted on its own
pm.when: Went silent at {at}, came back at {back}, after {d}.
dg.head: Check from neighbours
dg.none: Neighbour nodes haven't checked this address yet.
dg.v.agent: The server answers but the agent is silent: the agent is stopped or the way to the watchmen is blocked.
dg.v.hang: The network to the server is fine, but SSH doesn't answer: the system hung or crashed.
dg.v.dark: The server answers neither ping nor SSH: it's off or the hoster's network is down.
host.body: Server {ip} has been unreachable since {at}, for {d} now.
host.ask: Please check the server and the network on your side.
imp.now: Right now: {what}. All of them will be cut off.
imp.nobody: Nobody is connected right now, no one will be affected.
rb.title: Reboot
rb.now.text: All services will stop and start again. Alerts for the node will be muted for 10 minutes.
rb.warn.text: Players get messages 5 minutes and 1 minute before, the world is saved, then the node reboots.
rb.empty.text: The node waits until there are no players, connections or active tunnel peers, saves the world and reboots.
rb.say5: The server will restart in 5 minutes
rb.say1: Restarting in 1 minute, saving the world
rb.say5.label: Message 5 minutes before
rb.say1.label: Message 1 minute before
rb.hours: How long to wait before giving up
rb.empty.done: The node will reboot once it's empty
forget.text: The watchmen will forget the node and its history. If the agent is still running there, the node will reappear.
svcs.none: No services yet. Open a node and tap “Add” in the Services section.
ev.none: All quiet. Everything the panel alerts about shows up here: a node went silent or came back, a service failed, a disk is filling up.
set.hubs.text: A watchman keeps an eye on the nodes and tells the app when one goes silent. Two on different servers is safer.
set.live.text: The app stays connected to a watchman and reports trouble within seconds. A quiet status line sits in the notification shade.
set.eco.text: The app wakes up on a schedule. Barely uses battery, but you'll learn about a dead node with a delay.
set.battery: If alerts still don't arrive, check the phone's battery settings: some skins separately forbid apps from autostarting and running in the background.
hub.off.last: This is the only watchman. Without it the app gets no data and no alerts.
hub.off.text: The app will stop contacting it. It keeps running on the server.
hub.new.sub: Paste the key printed by the installer
hub.silent: The watchman isn't answering. Check that it's running and the port is open.
hub.silent.at: No answer from a watchman at {host}. Check that it's running and the port is open.
key.bad: This doesn't look like a watchman key. It starts with “laputa1:”.
key.bad.long: This doesn't look like a watchman key. It starts with “laputa1:” and is printed at the end of the installation.
ob.head: Connect a watchman
ob.text: A watchman runs on a server, keeps an eye on your nodes and tells the app when one goes silent. The installer prints a key. Paste it here.
log.browser: The log is only available in the app.
err.generic: The node didn't run the command
err.hub_garbage: The watchman sent a garbled answer
err.node_silent: {name} is silent, nobody to pass the command to
err.node_timeout: {name} didn't answer the command in time
err.empty_result: The agent sent an empty answer
err.no_init: This node has no systemd, so the panel can't see services here.
err.svc_name: A service name must end in .service or start with docker:
err.svc_exists: This service is already in the panel
err.svc_limit: This node already has 40 services in the panel, that's the limit
err.link_scheme: The link must start with https://, http:// or tg://
err.folder_missing: There's no folder {path} on the node
err.rcon_auth: The server rejected the RCON password
err.rcon_down: The server isn't answering RCON at {host}:{port}
err.game_off: No game server is connected to the panel
err.quick_limit: There are already 16 buttons, that's the limit
err.unknown_cmd: The agent on the node is older than the app and doesn't know the {cmd} command. Update it.
err.action_missing: This action is no longer in actions.ini
err.backup_exists: The panel already watches this folder
err.backup_limit: There are already 10 backup folders, that's the limit
ev.node_new.x: The agent checked in for the first time.
ev.node_down.x: No signal for over a minute.
ev.node_down.x.both: No signal for over a minute. Neither watchman can see it.
ev.node_down.x.group: No signal for over a minute. Other nodes at “{group}” went silent too.
ev.group_down.x: Everything at “{place}” at almost the same time. Looks like a power or internet outage there.
ev.node_up.x.panel: Back after a reboot from the panel, which took {gone}.
ev.node_up.x.link: This watchman didn't see it for {gone}.
ev.node_up.x.net: Was silent for {gone} but didn't reboot: the network dropped, not the server.
ev.node_up.x.bootc: Was silent for {gone} and rebooted. Cause: {cause}.
ev.link_lost.x: The other watchman sees the node. Looks like a broken link between them, the node itself is alive.
ev.hub_down.x: The node itself is alive, but its watchman isn't working. For now alerts only come through watchman {hub}.
ev.svc_stopped.x: {name}, {unit}. It wasn't stopped from the panel.
ev.reboot.x: Alerts for the node are muted for 10 minutes.
ev.reboot_gaveup.x: Reboot cancelled: someone was on the node for all {hours} h.
ev.boot_missing.x: These services were running before the reboot.
ev.backup_ok.t: Backups of {label} on {name} are back on track
ev.ssh_login.t.new: Login to {name} from a new address
j.hubs_lost.x: The phone is online, but no watchman has answered for {d}. Nodes are unwatched right now.
j.live: Laputa is connected to a watchman
j.test.x: This is what an alert about a silent node looks like.
j.net.pin: the watchman's certificate doesn't match the fingerprint in the key
j.net.https: the watchman address must start with https://
j.net.nopin: the watchman key has no certificate fingerprint
j.ch.alert.d: A node went silent or a service failed
j.ch.warn.d: Disk filling up, service stopped, watchmen unreachable
j.ch.info.d: A node or service came back
j.ch.status.d: A quiet permanent line while the app is connected to a watchman
j.act.muted: Alerts for {name} muted for an hour
j.w.nohub: Open Laputa and connect a watchman
node.reboot.sub: Command sent {ago}. Alerts for the node are muted until {at}.
h.reboot.sub: Alerts are muted while it reboots.
set.notify.text: For each kind of event. “Quiet” means no sound or vibration. “Don't send” only records the event in the Events tab.
nn.head: Notifications for this node
nn.text: Overrides the general settings for {name} only.
lvl.sound.text: Alerts arrive loud, warnings as a normal notification
lvl.quiet.text: The notification shows in the shade with no sound or vibration
lvl.off.text: No notification, the event is only recorded in the Events tab
set.notify.foot: You can change this for a single node on its screen.
